frontend.line: Sign-in redirect loop: login page is app/login/page.tsx (Clerk SignIn, path routing /login, redirect /dashboard); /login and any new public page must be in publicRoutes in middleware.ts. Staging loop from PR #828 is Lena's.
State: server state TanStack Query, client state zustand stores colocated with the feature (e.g. useInvoiceEditorStore); never mix. No Redux (ADR 0009; Lena wanted it for the invoice editor).
Tailwind v4 CSS-first config in apps/web/app/globals.css (@theme tokens); never create tailwind.config.js; use theme tokens (ring-primary), not hard-coded colors.

Dates: timestamps stored UTC; UI converts via next-intl useFormatter().dateTime (never toLocaleDateString(undefined) in SSR: hydration mismatch); due dates use formatDueDate, dueDate plain YYYY-MM-DD parsed local.

Money: format via formatMoney (apps/web/lib/money.ts) which rounds on decimal string (Number(`${amount}e2`)) since Math.round(amount*100) gave 2.005 -> 2.00; most callers pass cents/100, proper fix is formatting from integer cents; round each line to whole cents before summing.
Forms use react-hook-form + zodResolver (@hookform/resolvers/zod); examples invoice-form.tsx, org-form.tsx, client-form.tsx.

Web stack: Next.js 15.0.3 App Router; authenticated pages go in app/(dashboard)/ (sidebar/header, assumes signed-in), public in app/(marketing); group names not in URL; Lena wants /reports (app/(dashboard)/reports/page.tsx, Jordan has half-done edits). Clerk auth; Vercel preview per PR.
Icon-only buttons need aria-label (icon aria-hidden); use shadcn/ui from apps/web/components/ui and lucide-react, not hand-rolled icons; sweep of other unlabelled buttons deferred.
Only NEXT_PUBLIC_ env vars reach browser; Stripe one must be pk_ (publishable); .env.example has NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY=sk_test_replace_me (Lena), flagged not renamed.
InvoiceStatusBadge props: status (draft|sent|paid|overdue|void; renamed from kind) and size sm|md; invoice.kind means one-off vs recurring; labels via next-intl. Storybook on 6006.
UI copy: no exclamation marks in empty states; button label 'New invoice' everywhere, never 'Create invoice'.

i18n next-intl: new strings need keys in all of messages/{en,fr,es}.json; es invoices.status written by Claude, needs Spanish speaker; gaps: es settings.billing.portalLink/portalHint, stale fr invoices.filters.archived.
invoice.client may be null (imported invoices): type ClientSummary | null, show 'No client' (invoices.noClient); null-check always.
Form posts use server actions (decision July); no new files under app/api/ (webhooks only).
Checkbox in components/ui is Radix (button): use onCheckedChange (true|false|'indeterminate'), not onChange.

URL state: dashboard range ?range=<preset> default 30d via router.replace; customers sort lastActivity desc (nuqs, useCustomerQueryState); hook useInvoiceFilters renamed useInvoiceQueryState; text filters keep local state, debounce 300ms to URL.
Pending: settings/company form (company name required, tax id optional, sender email required) via server action saveCompany PATCH /v1/org/profile; page.tsx still to write.

code-style.line: Never mix TanStack Query (server) and zustand (client, colocated stores); no Redux (ADR 0009).
Logging: pino only (req.log / request.log in api, shared logger in worker); no console.log; never log whole request bodies; redact secrets/tokens.

Repo Node is 20.11 (engines >=20.11 <21), but the CLI (packages/cli, tsup target node18) must support Node 18+: no newer APIs without fallback (toSorted at src/commands/invoices-export.ts:27 needs one; avoid import.meta.dirname/filename).

Lint/format is Biome only (ESLint/Prettier dropped, PR #512): `pnpm lint`, `pnpm biome check --write <path>`, width 120; never add .eslintrc.json/.prettierrc (Lena's PR added them to apps/api; ask her to delete).
Validation is zod everywhere (no joi, no hand-rolled ifs); schemas in apps/api/src/schemas/; routes use safeParse, 400 invalid_body.
Data-access naming: list* functions (getInvoicesForClient renamed listClientInvoices).
CLI uses commander (replaced yargs in #409): each group exports registerX(program). TypeScript strict with noUncheckedIndexedAccess (NodeNext): indexing returns T | undefined.
No emojis in code, commit messages or docs.
Icon-only buttons need aria-label; use shadcn/ui and lucide-react.
Use @acme/shared/... path aliases (@acme/* -> packages/*/src), not deep relative imports.
CLI errors: throw UsageError (exit 2) for bad flags, never process.exit in handlers; others print message and exit 1 (packages/cli/src/lib/errors.ts).
Components under 150 lines with colocated tests; re-check for bugs/security before done.
CLI uses picocolors, not chalk; ui/table.ts pads by String.length so ANSI misaligns (pad on visible width).
API errors: RFC 7807 problem+json via problem() (apps/api/src/lib/problem.ts) incl. 400/404/409; soft delete with deleted_at, never hard delete.
Money stored as integer cents (amount_cents bigint), never floats; list endpoints use cursor pagination, never offset.
Standing rule: for any large refactor, show a plan first and wait for explicit approval before touching code.
ERR_REQUIRE_ESM fix: "type": "module" in package.json, local imports with .js extension, import/export not require/module.exports (applied to scripts/seed-demo).
Planned split of routes/invoices.ts on hold: computeTotals and loadInvoiceWithLines are imported by routes/payments.ts and emails/invoice-sent.tsx.

Unit tests Vitest (+ @testing-library/react in web), e2e Playwright; no jest/jest-dom; use toBeTruthy/toBeNull.
Missing tests: PR #479 empty/error/loading rendering; paid-at column (null paidAt, non-Toronto tz); CLI prompt path and non-TTY refusal; deliver-invoice-paid job (missing URL, non-2xx, timeout).

build-ci.line: Standing rule: never run destructive DB commands (drop, truncate, reset) without asking Jordan, even locally; local reset = remove volume acme-platform_dbdata, compose up db redis, migrate.ts then seed.ts.
Never run terraform/infra apply from a laptop; only CI plan/apply workflow (Priya). Local plan to paste in PR is fine.

Repo uses pnpm (not yarn); lint is Biome `pnpm lint`; web: `pnpm --filter web dev|test|build`. apps/web README still says yarn/ESLint (Jordan will update). Earlier yarn packageManager/frozen-lockfile notes are obsolete.

Local setup: clone acme/acme-platform, `nvm use`, `pnpm install`, copy .env.example to .env.local (NOT .env; values from Lena / 1Password acme-dev), `docker compose up -d db redis` (also mailpit), `pnpm --filter api db:migrate` once, `pnpm dev` (turbo: web, api 4000, worker). scripts/seed-demo needs Postgres and DATABASE_URL before `pnpm start`.
OpenAPI generated: `pnpm turbo run openapi --filter api`; never hand-edit YAML. turbo build depends on ^build and openapi.
Node 20.11 (moved off 18 on 2026-08-27, b71c0de); new laptops on Node 18 fail install with engines error.
CLI: commander, tsup bundle to dist/index.js; run from source `pnpm --filter @acme/cli dev -- <args>` with ACME_API_URL.
Secrets: dev 1Password acme-dev, prod AWS Secrets Manager; .env.example placeholders only.
Never run long benchmarks on shared CI; do not add PDF bench as a CI job (bench-pdf.ts refuses when CI set).
New env secret for api: add to `secrets:` list in infra/helm/api/values-prod.yaml (and staging), ESO sync, restart pods; infra/ needs Priya's review.
CI is GitHub Actions: .github/workflows/ci.yml; prod deploys from git tags v* via release.yml (~12 min).
release.yml build-images cache: cache-from and cache-to must use the same ref (lines 41-52); Jordan fixing.
Migrations: generate with `pnpm --filter api db:generate`, apply with `pnpm --filter api db:migrate` (drizzle-kit). Seed: `pnpm --filter api exec tsx scripts/seed.ts --reset` (faker.seed(20260921)).
Local ports: api 4000 (PORT in env.ts), worker API_URL defaults to http://localhost:4000.
CI uses `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: commit pnpm-lock.yaml with any dependency change or ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE.

Bundle size: `ANALYZE=true pnpm --filter web build` (apps/web/.next/analyze/). 2026-09-24 /dashboard 461 kB First Load JS (298 kB at last tag): recharts+d3 312 kB, @clerk/nextjs 88 kB, full date-fns locale 71 kB.

jobs.line: Acme moved off RabbitMQ: worker consumes BullMQ queues on Redis 7; Bull Board at /admin/queues on worker (basic auth), link that. Run locally: redis + `pnpm --filter worker dev`, metrics 9464.
Retry policy (queue/retry.ts, all consumers): maxRetries 3, backoff 1s/2s/4s, then DLQ (+Slack #alerts); ack after write. Supersedes 5 attempts.
Outage 2026-08-22: Redis hit maxmemory (noeviction) because BullMQ kept completed jobs; now removeOnComplete:1000, removeOnFail:5000 in services/worker/src/queues.ts (PR #819).
Marco wants rate limiter (services/worker/src/ratelimit.ts) Redis-backed in prod; review: take() must be an atomic Lua script, reset() must use SCAN not KEYS, add Redis-path test.
KEDA scales worker 1-20 replicas (1 per 50 msgs); manifests infra/k8s/.

Reminder idempotency (sendReminder.ts: sentAt check, conditional claim on claimedAt, idempotencyKey) needs migration adding nullable reminder.claimedAt; not written, Jordan said later (ORM is Drizzle, migrations in apps/api/drizzle, not Prisma).
Worker concurrency 5 per process (WORKER_CONCURRENCY, queues.ts); for month-end backlog raise max replicas, not per-process concurrency.
Dunning: apps/api/emails/payment-failed.tsx written but not hooked into mailer or dunning job; Jordan wants to review where it fires (billing flow).

events.invoice-paid (deliver-invoice-paid.ts) POSTs invoice.paid to orgs.callback_url, 10s timeout, throws on non-2xx for retry; enqueue in api payment-succeeded handler (billing) and tests still TODO.
image-resize lockDuration: 5000 but jobs take 7.5-9s, so they stall and run twice (144 on 2026-09-21); fix ~60000 or remove override; Jordan said later.

invoice-reminders queue: BullMQ scheduler daily 13:00 UTC (9:00 Toronto), one job per active org, enqueues email per invoice due in 3 days, jobId invoice-reminder:<invoiceId>:<date> (dedupe); pay link from api internal endpoint via worker env API_URL.

api enqueues BullMQ jobs (apps/api/src/jobs/queue.ts: emails, pdf-render, invoice-pdf-export); invoice-pdf-export (exportId, orgId, jobId invoice-pdf-export:<exportId>) not consumed by worker yet (next piece of acme-252).

Worker metrics :9464 /metrics via ServiceMonitor; BullMQ consumers moving to a new node group (needs priya/acme-212-redis-sg).

api.line: API is Fastify 5 (migrated from Express 4, PR #412, api 3.0.0): middleware are plugins in apps/api/src/plugins/ (auth, cors, rate-limit, request-id, error-handler); handlers take (request, reply); requireAuth verifies Clerk JWTs, 401 token_expired / invalid_token.
Validation zod only; schemas in apps/api/src/schemas/, safeParse -> 400 invalid_body.
Keep connectRetryWindowMs >= 120_000 (RDS failover 90s). Pool max 10 per pod (db/client.ts); pooler on 6432, prepare:false question open (see database).
Invoice endpoint includes lineItems only with expand=lineItems; only open invoices can be overdue.
CLI: `acme login` device flow, token in keytar; `--bom` for CSV; ACME_API_URL; apiGet retries 502/503/504 (staging 502s ~40s on deploys).
Every table has org_id; every query must filter by req.auth.orgId. JSON camelCase (totalCents); convert SUM() DECIMAL strings to numbers.
Drizzle: load relations explicitly via `with:` to avoid N+1; unfixed in routes/payments/list.ts, routes/clients/list.ts.

Cursor pagination (opaque cursor on created_at + id), never offset; decode cursor createdAt to Date for timestamptz comparisons (decodeCursor in lib/cursor.ts; InvalidCursorError = 400) else index unused.
Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json via problem() helper (lib/problem.ts); rows soft-deleted via deleted_at, lists/gets filter deleted_at IS NULL.
Money integer cents; invoices/totals.ts rounds each line's net and tax to whole cents then sums (fixed Northwind 1-cent mismatch); issued invoices keep stored totals.

Payments (read docs/architecture/payments.md): Stripe Checkout redirect, POST /v1/webhooks/stripe, stripe_events idempotent, job updates invoice status, payout.paid creates payouts; GET /v1/payouts (acme-238, PR #418); backfill of pre-migration payouts open.
DELETE /v1/customers/:id soft-deletes, 204; 400/404; 409 if open invoices (type URI .../customer-has-open-invoices, page missing); UI says 'Archive customer' (PR #427).
New public API fields: also update docs/api/invoices.md by hand; POST /v1/invoices has optional memo (<=500, internal only, migration 0042) and notes (<=2000, on PDF).
CSV exports (lib/csv.ts): RFC 4180 quoting, leading ' for = + - @, CRLF line endings kept (Jordan's choice), filename invoices-<org slug>.csv; customer-facing so mention in PR (acme-211-csv-export).
Parked: request timing plugin next to request-id. API is Fastify with drizzle and zod.
Drizzle schema apps/api/src/db/schema.ts is source of truth; generate migrations with `pnpm --filter api db:generate`; invoices.po_number (migration 0042) not yet in zod schemas or invoice DTO.
Refactor plan for routes/invoices.ts (917 lines) on hold; PDF and export.csv coverage 78.4% (below 80% gate).

deploy.line: Infra: Terraform 1.8.5 in infra/terraform, single AWS provider, us-east-1 for everything (no provider aliases without platform); S3 buckets acme-${var.env}-<name>, public access blocked, KMS (aws:kms). Pulumi removed 2026-08-26.
Never apply infra from a laptop; only CI plan/apply (Priya). Any change under infra/ needs platform team review and terraform plan output pasted into the PR description.
Tag every taggable resource with team and env; Jordan's team=payments; only aws_s3_bucket taggable among bucket sub-resources.
